title: dendrobium kingianum var. subquadratum
intro: Dendrobium kingianum var. subquadratum, commonly known as a type of orchid, is a plant species native to Australia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dendrobium kingianum var. subquadratum include its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
